name: list_files
description: List non-sensitive files in a relative directory.

name: read_file
description: Read a UTF-8 file before modifying it. Paths are relative; returns at most 200 lines.

name: search
description: Search text files using a regular expression.

name: create_file
description: Create a new UTF-8 file in the isolated workspace.

name: patch_file
description: Replace exactly one matching text fragment. Requires a fresh read_file first.

name: delete_file
description: Delete an existing file from the isolated workspace. Requires a fresh read_file first.

name: git_status
description: Inspect Git status of the isolated workspace.

name: list_verification_profiles
description: List operator-configured test, lint, and build profiles available for this workspace.

name: run_verification
description: Run one operator-configured verification profile in a disposable copy of the isolated workspace. The profile command cannot be changed by the model.
